description: Rochester, NY – Today, the Laborers International Union of North America Local 435 endorsed Joe Morelle in the race for the for the 25th Congressional District. Local 435 celebrates its 100th anniversary this year and represents almost 1,000 workers.

title: Laborers Endorse Morelle - Joe Morelle for Congress
